entity_raw.definition_raw: Torture SubdomainSource Book of the Damned pg. 182, Inner Sea Gods pg. 227, Goblins of Golarion pg. 27Associated Domain(s): DestructionAssociated Deities: Ananshea, Andak, Ozranvial, Venkelvore, Vevelor, Xsistaid, Yamasoth, Zaebos, Zaigasnar, ZeparReplacement Power: The following granted power replaces the destructive smite power of the Destruction domain.Painful Smite (Su): Prior to making a melee attack roll, you can choose to convert all damage from that strike into nonlethal damage, adding your Wisdom modifier to the damage. If your attack hits, as a free action you can attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize the target. You gain a bonus on this Intimidate check equal to the amount of nonlethal damage dealt by the painful smite. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. Replacement Domain Spells: 2nd—pain strike, 5th— symbol of pain, 8th—demand.
